overview: The subcommittee reviewed and advanced an annual reporting and presentation schedule alongside several district policy updates required for state compliance and operational clarity. All recommended policies—spanning student equity, homeless and foster care student supports, military families, crowdfunding, and staff gifts—were approved to be forwarded to the full School Committee.

items.title: Annual Reports and Presentation Schedule Policy
items.summary: Approved forwarding the draft policy and schedule of recurring annual presentations and financial reviews to the full School Committee with minor adjustments.

items.title: Policy JB: Equal Educational Opportunities
items.summary: Approved and referred the updated equal educational opportunities policy to the full committee with revised wording concerning physical and intellectual abilities.

items.title: Policy JFABD: Homeless Student Support Services
items.summary: Approved the updated policy for state compliance with amendments clarifying district liaison assistance for immunizations and removing obsolete program references.

items.title: Policy JFABE: Educational Opportunities for Military Children
items.summary: Approved the policy with amendments expanding grade coverage from pre-K through age 22 transition programs, pending confirmation of legal terminology.

items.title: Policy GBEBD: Online Fundraising and Crowdfunding
items.summary: Approved a new crowdfunding policy establishing central oversight, asset tracking for donated property, and an annual reporting requirement.

items.title: Policy GBEBC: Gifts to and Solicitations by Staff
items.summary: Approved an ethics-aligned policy confirming that classroom-directed gifts remain the property of the school district.

items.title: Policy JFABF: Educational Opportunities for Children in Foster Care
items.summary: Approved adopting a standalone model policy for foster care student stability to comply with Department of Elementary and Secondary Education review requirements.
